apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC is a Flutter music app built around installable extensions: an extension supplies the metadata and the audio downloads for one provider, so sources can be added or repaired without an app update. Downloads land in a local library with lyrics, cover art, quality badges and duplicate detection.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New Features

- **library**: Sort songs and albums by file size
- **desktop**: Add fullscreen and borderless window modes
- **library**: List the files a scan could not read
- **downloads**: Add custom folder path templates
- **network**: Add Subsonic and OpenSubsonic support
- **windows**: Prepare native ARM64 builds and packages
- **player**: Color the current track row from its artwork
- **desktop**: Open the mini player on Windows and Linux

### Bug Fixes

- **desktop**: List full screen and borderless shortcuts
- **automix**: Verify beat alignment and hold phase through the mix
- **home**: Keep explore artwork square
- **flutter**: Backport semantics geometry crash fix
- **tags**: Support ID3-prefixed FLAC metadata writes
- **library**: Keep playlists accessible without local songs
- **conversion**: Preserve quoted paths in lossy exports
- **library**: Index songs whose tags fail to parse
- **playback**: Allow MP3 playback with malformed ID3 tags
- **automix**: Start the next song on the outgoing beat
- **desktop**: Keep artist album selection and scroll position
- **android**: Refresh media controls when track metadata changes
- **windows**: Use the MSVC coroutine deprecation macro's real name
- **windows**: Install the libmpv license and build on MSVC 14.5x
- **library**: Keep liked local tracks visible during cover fades
- **windows**: Support UNC library paths and network downloads
- **desktop**: Restore private file access after cache removal
- **notifications**: Handle Linux launch callbacks and contain queue alerts
- **repo**: Move the store button under the text on narrow rows
- **library**: Simplify duplicate review rows and expose load errors
- **settings**: Keep final controls clear of floating playback bars
- **home**: Collapse the empty prompt after installing an extension
- **library**: Emphasize Play in collection header actions
- **library**: Read tagless audio without losing document names
- **desktop**: Wrap search and store category filters
- **desktop**: Add scroll arrows to artist and recent shelves
- **settings**: Restore 5.2.1 card contrast
- **network**: Flush and verify SMB uploads before publishing
- **android**: Resolve SAF audio paths when saving lyrics
- **desktop**: Handle missing initial download folders

### Refactoring

- **onboarding**: Remove the rebrand introduction tour

### Testing

- **library**: Expect the sort sheet to scroll at its cap
- **player**: Cover mini player metadata refresh and session restore

### Chores

- Update AltStore source to v5.2.5 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])
- Bump version to 5.2.6 (165)
- **license**: Adopt LGPL-3.0-only for Mornye




**Full Changelog**: [v5.2.5...v5.2.6](https://github.com/mornyeapp/Mornye/compare/v5.2.5...v5.2.6)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-arm32.apk` (older devices)
- `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `Mornye-v5.2.6-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the SHA-256 of every file above.

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA
